description: 与恩布拉共同成为最早人类的人类始祖之一。
fullDescription: 《女预言家之歌》17–18节描述神祇发现阿斯克与恩布拉时二者尚缺乏生命与命运，随后获得生命相关的能力。文本并不要求把阿斯克画成树人，也没有给出维京时代服装。卡图应表现‘刚获得生命的人’，而不是木头怪物或成熟战士。
roleInSeries: 把M01从宇宙创生推进到人类出现。

sourceRefs.note: 阿斯克与恩布拉被发现并获得生命相关能力。

visualThesis: 刚刚苏醒的人类男性，身体与肤色自然，带有初次感知海风、光与世界的惊异；只用非常克制的木质来源暗示。

sourceBoundFacts: 与恩布拉共同成为最早人类
来源强调从无生命状态到获得生命/感知的转变
interpretationNotes: Ask常与ash/白蜡树联系，但不应把他硬画成树人
具体年龄、肤色、衣物不详
canon.worldState: 世界已经形成基本海陆，但人类文明尚不存在。
mustKeep: 面部年轻但非现代时尚模特
简单无时代感遮体织物或自然遮挡

instructions: 与恩布拉：不是男女同模换脸；阿斯克可更偏站起/触地的动作，恩布拉偏感知风与光
两者必须共享世界阶段和材质语言但各自构图独立

visual.detailHierarchy: 脸、手与初醒动作高细节；海岸低细节。
visual.subjectSeparation: 自然肤色与柔化海岸背景分离。

prompt.draft: Create Ask as a newly awakened first human on the young world coast. He must look fully human, not a tree person, and not a Viking warrior. Show a natural adult male body and face experiencing life and the world for the first time, with a quiet grounded pose such as touching wet wood, stone or air. Use only a subtle origin-from-wood suggestion in nearby material, not bark skin or branches growing from him. No village, longhouse, weapons, armor or historical Viking clothing. Keep the young coast simple and atmospheric. Distinguish him clearly from Embla through pose, face and silhouette. Crop-safe head and torso, restrained painterly style.

Show a natural adult male body and face experiencing life and the world for the first time, with a quiet grounded pose such as touching wet wood, stone or air. Visual thesis: 刚刚苏醒的人类男性，身体与肤色自然，带有初次感知海风、光与世界的惊异；只用非常克制的木质来源暗示。

Identity anchors: 自然人类；初醒感；海岸/新生世界；非战士

Must keep: 面部年轻但非现代时尚模特；简单无时代感遮体织物或自然遮挡；木质来源只弱提示

Must avoid: 树人；树皮皮肤；维京战士装备；成熟村落；现代服装；英雄持剑姿势

Composition: camera eye level; shot three-quarter awakening figure; keep the primary subject/action inside the crop-safe upper-middle area.

Match the established M01 artwork family: painterly mythic realism with matte surfaces, broad readable shapes, controlled cinematic blue-white frost and restrained ember light, atmospheric depth, limited focal sharpness, and restrained brush detail. Subject or key moment must be sharper and more contrasted than the background. Use mythology-first visual storytelling rather than generic AI fantasy. Keep at most one primary environmental motif and one secondary motif; preserve quiet areas and clear visual hierarchy. Compose for future card crop safety: the face, hands, identity symbol, key object, or story action must work in the upper-middle area; the bottom 30 percent may be sacrificed.

Color and material guidance: palette 浅肤自然色；海灰蓝；湿木褐; materials 皮肤；湿木；海雾；粗织物; mood newborn；human；quiet；wonder.

Related card IDs for narrative continuity only: 1003010008. Preserve their mythic relationship without cloning faces, silhouettes, or poses.

Avoid these failure modes: tree person；bark skin；branches growing from body；Viking warrior；armor；weapon；longhouse；modern fashion；typography；glossy game-CG; excessive particles, floating debris overload, glossy game-CG, hyper-detailed-everything, random glowing runes, generic Viking cosplay, modern copyrighted adaptation, malformed anatomy, extra limbs, unreadable hands or props.

Fill one complete portrait 9:16 canvas with no margins. Target final canvas at least 1620x2880 pixels.
